Slice **R-185-BR2** of the v18.5.0 release test sweep, round 1 (wave anchor #33761). Selector `touched:181ad7d4` (295 items after the `priority:P0` cut) is filed in three slices; this record is the browser/mixed slice for areas records-forms, search, studio-authoring and ux-conventions: **61 items**. The other two slices (R-185-API, R-185-BR1) and R-P0 are separate records.

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework: objectstack-ai/objectstack `main` @ `a557fa386bc3119379b1525bade763d00578396d` (2026-11-15 09:05Z); the console builds from `ui/` in the same tree. 18.4.0 = tag `181ad7d4` (`chore: version packages (#29963)`).
- Build: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (20 s); `turbo build --concurrency=2` over the showcase + cli + dogfood closure, 70 packages (7m17s; spec built with declarations, `OS_SKIP_DTS` unset); `pnpm console:build --concurrency=2`, 76 tasks (6m16s); `objectstack compile` of the showcase once (the self-ping connectors compiled at the default `http://127.0.0.1:3000`, so connector-dependent legs ran on scratch copies).
- App: stock showcase (`examples/app-showcase`). Boots: `pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --no-compile --no-watch --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:/tmp/qa4/GROUP/ITEM/data.db` with `OS_PORT`, `OS_HOME` and `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT` per boot; install, self-ping and app-source legs on a scratch copy (`WS/examples/app-showcase` + symlinked `packages`/`node_modules`) compiled under its own port. One walled `group` boot via `node scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs walled-boot` (record-discussion-mentions).
- Ports 41250–41299 (six runner groups, 8–10 ports each); own file DB per item or per non-interfering batch. Seed: `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai), contributor members via `qa-fixture.mjs contributor-member`, other personas via invite + sign-up + accept-invitation or `admin/create-user`, identity proven by `GET /auth/get-session` before each persona cell.
- Browser: headless Chromium (Playwright, `/opt/pw-browsers` build), sign-in through the console form on `http://localhost:PORT/_console/`. Live e2e specs under `ui/e2e/live/` were not run (their globalSetup writes `ui/e2e/live/.auth/state.json` into the shared tree); every clause they pin was driven by hand. One showcase smoke spec (`examples/app-showcase`, view-type-gallery A5) ran against its own boot: 7 surfaces, 7 passed.
- Pins: vitest `--maxWorkers=1`, one package per invocation, from `ui/` for objectui suites; each cited pin names its layer in the clause row.
- Tree hygiene after the run: `git status` clean, `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages/` absent, `dist/objectstack.json` unchanged since the lead's compile.
- Runner: one QA runner thread for qa#3, six runner subagents (opus, effort high), at most three in parallel. Run 09:39–12:20Z.

## FAIL rows and their reproduction rules

### ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason · acceptance[1] · fail · product defect

FAIL-REPRO (A1): as admin open /_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task → Import → upload a CSV whose headers match no field (foo,bar) → mapping step; press Tab repeatedly: focus visits 'No saved templates' select, the span wrapping disabled 'Save current' (data-testid import-template-save-btn), then the dialog DIV, then loops — import-next-btn's wrapper span, both '— Skip —' selects, Cancel, Back, Close are unreachable; Shift+Tab sticks on the dialog DIV. Expected: Tab reaches every tabbable in the dialog (8 listed by DOM). Control: CSV title,project (Save current enabled) → Tab visits all 8; CSV title,foo (Save current enabled, Next disabled-wrapped) → Tab reaches the Next span. So the Tooltip-wrapped reason span around the disabled Save current (ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx, the nothingMapped branch added by #31557) breaks the dialog's Tab sequence. Reproduced on 4 fresh loads (with and without a prior hover), real keyboard events. Disposition: product defect (keyboard users cannot map columns or leave by keyboard once a file maps nothing). Regression vs 18.4.0: n (likely) — #31557 (2c6b93644, 2026-11-08) is an ancestor of 181ad7d4; not re-measured on an 18.4.0 build.

- Disposition: **product defect**, extracted as #33862. Reproduced on four fresh loads with real keyboard events; automation self-check: the same driver reaches every stop in the two control files (`title,project` and `title,foo`). Trap `automation-input` ruled out (keyboard, not coordinates). Not a regression versus 18.4.0 as far as source shows: #31557 (2c6b93644) is an ancestor of `181ad7d4`.

## PARTIAL items — what is missing

- **records-forms.delete-toast-undo-restore**: N1 not-run as the item directs. Bin retention read back retentionDays 30 (GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task/recycle-bin). The 2 bulk-deleted tasks were restored afterwards through the bin API.
- **records-forms.encrypted-field-behavior**: A3 blocked(fixture) per knownGaps[1] (confirmed: the os dev boot wrote aes-256-gcm ciphertext). f_password is plaintext at rest by design (ackPlaintextMasking) — DB column holds it; masked on every read observed.
- **records-forms.gantt-interactions**: A1 and A2's auto-schedule half blocked(fixture) by design (no dependenciesField on stock view).
- **records-forms.record-discussion-mentions**: A7 changes_only leg — fixtures.knownGaps[3] assumes a record:discussion panel on an object with field history would offer it; staged one on boot C (qafeeds_milestone enable.trackHistory true, audit rows present, page qafeeds_milestone_detail with record:discussion) and it still offers three modes: RecordDetailView reads field history only for the synthesized page (ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:2858 historyPage = historyEnabled && !assignedPage && …), so RecordFieldHistoryContext is false under any authored page and getFilterOptions never adds changes_only. Same line at 18.4.0 (181ad7d4) — not a regression. Disposition: stale knownGap / spec question (is changes_only meant to exist on an authored panel at all?), not filed as a defect. Mention target note: the autocomplete's first entry for '@G3' was 'G3 Other', so g3other is the mentioned user and g3ment the non-mentioned one in A3/A4.
- **search.command-palette-navigation**: inactive-app half blocked(fixture), knownGaps[2] confirmed. Console log for session: one pre-login 401 (get-session before sign-in) only.
- **studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix**: knownGaps[3] confirmed — one runner's budget reaches a slice of the matrix (8 rows here, #31486 drove 9 others); the split is still owed. NOT JUDGEABLE rows (knownGaps[1]) not attempted. dashboard.requiredPermissions stored-check needs a capability holder (fixture). Census (step 4): field 'Parent' inspector shows a 'Delete Behavior' control → deleteBehavior has a Studio control now and leaves the matrix (not a fail); no 'multiple' control found on the lookup inspector, no 'sortable' control found (text scan of the panel, indicative).

## Off-clause probes (RUNNER rule 8)

About 55 minutes in total (6–10 min per group), on the items' own boots, as the admin and member personas. Boundary classes tried: empty string, missing id, unknown id, stale/garbage `If-Match`, wrong-case / not-yet-created package ids, publish-time vs draft-time validation; readers outside scope (member against admin rows, foreign records, recycle bins, audit log, preference rows, notifications of another user, approvals outside scope); opposite posture (walled `group` beside `single` for discussion recipients).

- Extracted from probes: #33863 (palette Enter after a one-event query replace), #33864 (labels convention misses on five surfaces), #33865 (two writes with no feedback).
- Observed, not filed: a numeric string `"12"` written to a number field is stored as 12; a pair override declaring `overrides.basedOn: '9.9.9'` (a version the base never had) is accepted 200 at draft; invalid CEL conditions and negative retry counts are accepted as hook drafts and refused at publish for the whole batch; `If-None-Match: *` on a published hook with no draft answers 200 in draft mode (the create-only check reads the draft, as the code intends).
- Everything else answered as the contract says (400/404 on boundaries, 403 or a non-disclosing 404 outside scope, no draft leaks to non-authors). One further probe finding is the withheld row above.
